description: Inkable Label Co. (inkablelabel.com): the website's own price for any label or custom tissue paper product the website prices online, worked out by inkablelabel.com when you ask, and a link that opens the product page with these options selected. The customer adds to cart, uploads files and pays on the website first, then gets a proof. Most products take 3–10 days after proof approval. Anything the website doesn't price online returns quote_required.
